description: This file defines the 'DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy' class which extends 'PurgeStrategy'. It implements a method to purge candidate entities related to a specific vacancy, removing entities that do not have consent to keep data.

classes.name: DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class that handles purging Candidate entities associated with a vacancy, deleting those that lack consent to retain data.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes candidate records associated with the given vacancy ID if they do not have consent to keep data.
